topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: The news of the town’s well-loved tavern shutting its doors has fallen on me like a late frost on spring crops. The hearth where many a night I’ve warmed my bones and filled my belly with hearty fare, it seems, shall no longer crackle with the laughter of friends and the clink of mugs. The thought of it brings a heaviness to my step, a cloud over what little sunlight we get these days. I shall miss the scent of roasting meat and the tales of travels far and wide, all shared within those walls. A part of our village, it seems, will go dark, and with it, a bit of what made our days bright. May the saints watch over the souls who once found joy there.
